people.name: Enoch
people.line: A righteous man who walked with God.

people.name: Methuselah
people.line: The oldest person mentioned in the Bible.

translations.web: Enoch lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Methuselah.
translations.bsb: When Enoch was 65 years old, he became the father of Methuselah.
translations.kjv: And Enoch lived sixty and five years, and begat Methuselah:
